task.title: Release desktop sign-in may send the untrusted 127.0.0.1 origin
task.description:
Discovered during the local-dev sign-in fix (2026-08-15): account::sign_in / sign_up / verify_email compute their upstream Better Auth origin from request_origin(&headers) alone, unlike google_sign_in which prefers native::embedded_origin(). The Tauri RELEASE desktop window navigates to http://127.0.0.1:<dynamic port>, so release-build email/password sign-in likely sends an origin Neon Auth does not trust — the same class of failure the dev fix addressed for web (dev desktop was unaffected only because devUrl uses localhost). Unverified since the 2026-07-13 spike, which predates current Neon Auth behavior.

To do: build a release desktop app (cargo tauri build, host only) and smoke email/password sign-in. If it fails with 'Invalid origin', make the account:: server fns prefer native::embedded_origin() the way google_sign_in does — likely a small, self-contained fix. See specs/auth.md Findings (2026-08-15 entry).
